description:
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {0}, since its cost is reduced by Aang, Master of Elements.
When Sparkcaster enters, each of its abilities trigger.
Resolve one Sparkcaster ability, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the other Sparkcaster ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements
